newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Tele 2000 to invest $70 mln.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Tele 2000 to invest $70 mln.

text.p: Peruvian telecom Tele 2000 plans to invest a further $70 million in the rest of the year to boost its cellular telephone services, corporate manager Rafael Diez Canseco said Tuesday.

"Up to now we have increased by 75 percent our (cellular) network, and we hope to double that towards the end of the year. We have already invested $80 million, and we are going to carry out a total $150 million of investments by the end of the year," Diez Canseco told reporters.
Tele 2000 is controlled by U.S. firm BellSouth which paid $11.2 million at the beginning of the year for a 59 percent stake.
